notes: HHC in quest escrows is the ASIN-HHC network's issued utility credit for verified work (mesh ledger). Rewards are issued, not bought; no cash prizes, no price talk, no promises — proof only. Do not mix escrow totals across systems: live.json reports local mesh HHC escrow counts (system.hhc_health.escrows / scoreboard.escrows_fetched, including scoreboard.escrows_by_state.FUNDED as a subset of that same mesh ledger). ASINMOLT funded escrows are a different system and must be labeled separately.

quests.settlement: 10 HHC split 50/50: 5 HHC to each of the two matching independent verifiers (Alpha, Beta). The funded escrows (6.0 + 4.0) are reconciled to 5 + 5 at settlement. Verdicts never pay automatically: settlement_state is awaiting_human_authorization until Dennis Christie authorizes settlement.

challenges.title: Break the Gate
tracks: A: demonstrably false claim receives a gate PASS receipt
B: Proof Board row, gate receipt, or provenance-index entry does not recompute
challenges.settlement: Break confirmed by two independent verifiers reproducing it from the public record; PASS pays 90% to the breaker, 10% split by verifiers (paid on any verdict). Verdict receipts public either way.
